'''House Zirkonn''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Blaise Zirkonn/Legends|Blaise Zirkonn]] served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
